symptom: After the document types took Studio Pro's names (ako/mxcli#755, R10), "mxcli describe --help and the catalog.db still use the old names": the help listed restclient / odataclient / odataservice / queue / projectsecurity / model, and the catalog exposed REST_CLIENTS, REST_OPERATIONS, ODATA_CLIENTS, ODATA_SERVICES, QUEUES with ObjectType REST_CLIENT / ODATA_CLIENT / ODATA_SERVICE / QUEUE
cause: The R10 rename was done on the MDL grammar and describe output only. The cobra describe command keeps its own type table, help text, error hint and auto-detect maps (objectTypeToDescribe, unitTypeToDescribe), and the catalog's view names and objects.ObjectType literals are a second vocabulary nobody migrated
file: `cmd/mxcli/cmd_describe.go`, `mdl/catalog/tables.go` (canonical views + `LegacyTableAliases`/`legacyAliasView`, objects view, schema 24), `mdl/catalog/catalog.go` (`Tables()`), consumers in `mdl/executor/describe_auto.go`, `cmd/mxcli/lsp_completion.go`, `.claude/lint-rules/conv018_module_folder_organization.star`
insight: A language rename has more vocabularies than the grammar: grep the OLD spelling in every form it takes — `rest client`, `restclient`, `REST_CLIENT`, `rest_clients` — not just the keyword, since the CLI subcommand table and catalog SQL never pass through the parser and the deprecation registry cannot see them. Table names can keep an alias (a `CREATE VIEW old AS SELECT * FROM new`, exempted from TestTables_CoversAllViews via LegacyTableAliases); ObjectType literal values cannot, so a user query filtering on the old value silently returns zero rows — keep the old keys in every Go map that reads ObjectType (a pre-bump cache still holds them) and say so in the docs. Renaming a view needs a CatalogSchemaVersion bump: views are CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS, so a cached catalog keeps the old objects view. Repro mdl-examples/bug-tests/1395-studio-pro-document-names-catalog.mdl; end-to-end on testdata/testapp-views: OBJECTS reports PUBLISHED_ODATA_SERVICE, CATALOG.ODATA_SERVICES still answers, and `describe MyFirstModule.CarOdataApi` auto-detects through the new value. Issue mendixlabs/mxcli#1395
